The main takeaway from our work is that
the flicker-noise upconversion mechanism is a strong function of harmonic terminations, which are not well understood and often neglected.
the 3rd-order harmonic termination is critical to suppress flicker noise up-conversion in mmW CMOS oscillators, which is in stark contrast to conventional intuition.
